scenario.name: m3_wash_sensor_fault
scenario.description: Closed loop, but the pressure sensor sticks mid-run: detected as sensor_disagreement, distrusted, model takes over.

events.narration: Load 10,000 capsules through the top inlet; they settle in a single layer behind the weir.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 3 simulated (0 rejected): load 14.7 uL at 40 uL/min, predicted 22 s, 63.2% exchanged, peak 2.00 kPa.

events.narration: Wash 2 x 39.7 uL (the volume of three 20 uL washes, cut to fit the chamber): buffer flows past the weir to waste while the capsules stay behind it.

events.narration: Back-flush from the far side to lift the capsules off the weir and resuspend them.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 8 simulated (5 rejected): exchange back-flush 1 x 39.7 uL resuspension_buffer at 60 uL/min, predicted 40 s, 94.2% exchanged, peak -3.00 kPa.

events.narration: Flush the washed capsules out through the release outlet: 44.1 uL at 30 uL/min. The volume is about three trap volumes because a release has to SWEEP the chamber, not just fill it, and the flow is the lift flow because below it the capsule bed does not come off the weir.
